title: in-house video and sound player, with the media tools (manual until automated)

clauses.text: With the media tools installed, MEDIA and the menu's Media player play a video with its sound through IYAKKI's own player.

steps.do: Open a video in MEDIA, or from the IYAKKI menu use Media player.
steps.expect: The pictures move at the video's speed and the sound comes from the speakers.

clauses.text: Space pauses, the arrows, f and Esc do what the page says.

steps.do: Press Space to pause and again to resume. Press the arrow keys, then f for full screen, then Esc.
steps.expect: Each key does what its name says. Pause holds the picture and sound, and the picture is back in step with the sound after resume.

clauses.text: The progress bar can be clicked to seek, and the time shows the new position.

steps.do: Click a point on the progress bar.
steps.expect: The video jumps to that time with sound from there, and the time shows the new position.

clauses.text: An info line names the codec, size, frame rate, sound and length.

steps.do: Read the info line for the video.
steps.expect: It names the codec, the picture size, the frame rate, whether there is sound, and the length.

clauses.text: Pictures wait for the sound: the sound is the clock and late pictures are dropped.

steps.do: Play a longer video for two minutes and watch a clap or lip movement against the sound.
steps.expect: The picture and sound stay together. Say if they drift, or if a delay shows at pause and resume (a short lag at pause is expected).

clauses.text: The volume in Settings, Sound applies to the video.

steps.do: Change the volume in Settings, Sound while a video plays.
steps.expect: The video's loudness changes with it.

clauses.text: A camera recording in .avi plays in this player.

steps.do: Open a .avi recording made by the camera (if you have one) in MEDIA or the Media player.
steps.expect: The recording plays with picture and sound.

clauses.text: Without the media tools, MEDIA and the Media player say: Install the media player: Store → Setup → Media tools, and the Media page has an Install button.

steps.do: On a device without the media tools, open a video in MEDIA.
steps.expect: The page says: Install the media player: Store → Setup → Media tools. An Install button is shown on the Media page.
